name: Saikai National Park
description: National park (1955) of the western Nagasaki coast: the 208 islands of the Kujukushima archipelago, the Hirado strait and the Goto islands.
notes: Designated 1955 (24,646 ha). The Kujukushima Pearl Sea Resort cruise from Sasebo is the classic view.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
